moment: The act is not narrated. It is held. And holding it is a different act than the one the voice described, and the different act is the one that costs the lever, and the cost of the lever is the only thing in this room that the ledger cannot work on, and the ledger is waiting for a flinch that is not coming, and the flinch is not coming, and the not-coming is the act you chose, and the act you chose is the one that is not narrated.
style: Engraved etching illustration, dense crosshatching, fine ink linework, monochrome, no colour. Heavy blacks, high contrast, deep shadow, dark inked plate. The characters are anthropomorphic cats.
